summary_md: **Dante Martin ([@DanteMMartin](https://x.com/DanteMMartin/status/2115454293658776058))** points to a r/LocalLLaMA story where someone used **Qwen 3.8 Flash** on an underpowered PC to root an LG TV and strip its adware, framing local models as a repair tool for hardware you already own.
